locator.name: never prints a zero for a series the server named no generation for (S8)

proves.facet: A degraded master answer (generation null, currentness unmeasured, zero counters) renders the unmeasured state with no numeric total and a disclosure that no base and no selected result resolved.

1.note: The change-set bar suite retains the exact generation-bound master series entry and compact Intent review controls: a closed leaf's control supplies review: {} — the page's own default, which for a landed leaf is the delivered pair — and explicitly has no review-subject picker, even when knowledge is unavailable; a live leaf supplies the same review: {} and the closed one alone is labelled (recorded), leaving subject selection to the reviewer.
